info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Hold Management API
info.description: The Hold Management API facilitates the process of placing a hold on specific settlements identified by their unique settlementId. This service ensures accurate financial operations by allowing users to temporarily restrict transactions related to designated settlements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors seeking to manage settlement disputes or fulfill regulatory requirements. This API streamlines the hold process while maintaining transaction integrity across the financial system.

post.description: This operation allows you to place a hold on a specific settlement identified by its unique identifier. A hold prevents further processing of the settlement until it is released. Use this endpoint to ensure that the settlement remains unchanged until necessary actions are taken.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a hold operation for the specified settlement with ID RES-100045. Ensure that all required parameters are correctly provided to successfully execute the operation.
